text: Which one of the following is a determinant of aggregate demand?
options: A) Availability of credit
B) Cost of inputs
C) State of technology
D) Change in productivity

text: What is the effect of an exogenous increase in government spending?
options: A) Aggregate demand shifts to the right increasing both output and price level.
B) Aggregate demand shifts to the left increasing both output and price level
C) Aggregate demand shifts to the left decreasing output and increasing price level.
D) Aggregate demand shifts to the right increasing output but decreasing price level.

text: Which one of the following is correct about factors affecting aggregate supply?
options: A) Higher price of imported raw materials leads to firms to produce more.
B) Lower demand for commodities in the market initiates firms to produce more.
C) Subsidizing domestic industry in technology leads to decrease production.
D) Qualified high managerial ability leads to firms to produce more production.

text: Among the following statements, which one is correct about the short-run aggregate supply curve?
options: A) It shows the quantity demanded at different price levels, ceteris paribus.
B) It reveals that as price level rises, firms decrease the quantity supplied of goods.
C) It shows the quantity supplied of output at various price levels, ceteris paribus.
D) It reveals that as price level drops, firms increase the quantity supplied of goods.

text: Which one of the following is true about short-run equilibrium in the economy?
options: A) The occurrence of a shortage of goods leads to firms decrease output and consumption decrease consumption.
B) It is the intersection of aggregate demand and aggregate supply.
C) The occurrence of a surplus of goods leads to firms decrease output and consumption increase consumption.
D) It is the intersection of long-run and short-run aggregate supply curves.

text: Suppose the price level changed from the equilibrium of aggregate demand and short run aggregate supply in an economy. Which of the following is true about the result?
options: A) At a lower price level, there will be surplus, and the price level decreases.
B) At a higher price level there will be shortage, and the price level increases.
C) At a lower price level, there will be shortage and the price level rises.
D) At a higher price level there will be surplus, and the price level increases

text: Which one of the following is a solution for the market failure caused by a firm that pollutes a river?

D) Renting the polluted river

text: Which one of the following explains the free rider problem in an economy?
options: A) Free ridership is a problem that arises due to the excludable nature of public goods.
B) Individuals get the benefits of public goods without contributing anything to the cost.
C) All individuals have the incentive to pay for the public good.

text: Among the following alternatives, which one represents a positive externality?

D) Overgrazing cows in the common pasture lands

text: Asymmetric information is a situation when;
options: A) buyers and sellers have different types of information.
B) buyers and sellers have the same type of information.
C) buyers and sellers want to be free riders.
D) buyers and sellers lack agreement on the price.

text: When an individual builds on their skills by acquiring more education/training, the individual is trying to
options: A) free ride the employer.
B) screen the employer.

D) signal to the employer.

text: In a free market for labor, the wage rate is determined such that

text: Which one of the following is the disadvantage of the floating exchange rate regime?
